verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, You have searched me and known me.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, You have searched me and known me.

verses.text: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.

segments.text: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.

verses.text: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.

segments.text: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.

verses.text: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.

segments.text: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.

verses.text: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.

segments.text: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.

verses.text: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.

segments.text: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.

verses.text: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?

segments.text: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?

verses.text: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.

segments.text: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.

verses.text: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,

segments.text: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,

verses.text: even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.

segments.text: even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.

verses.text: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—

segments.text: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—

verses.text: even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.

segments.text: even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.

verses.text: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

segments.text: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

verses.text: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.

segments.text: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.

verses.text: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.

segments.text: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.

verses.text: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.

segments.text: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.

verses.text: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!

segments.text: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!

verses.text: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.

segments.text: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.

verses.text: O God, that You would slay the wicked—away from me, you bloodthirsty men—

segments.text: O God, that You would slay the wicked—away from me, you bloodthirsty men—

verses.text: who speak of You deceitfully; Your enemies take Your name in vain.

segments.text: who speak of You deceitfully; Your enemies take Your name in vain.

verses.text: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?

segments.text: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?

verses.text: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.

segments.text: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.

verses.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.

segments.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.

verses.text: See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
